{{About|the list of Matcha Flavoured releases|features in development|Upcoming features}}
This page lists every published version of [[Matcha Flavoured]]. Each version has its own page describing its changes, based on the official release notes. The current version is {{Version|{{Current version}}|{{Current version}}-beta}}.

Versions are published on Modrinth. Until 1.12.1-alpha the datapack and resource pack were one archive, and from 1.12.2-beta they are published as two files. Since [[Matcha Flavoured 1.12.1-alpha|1.12.1-alpha]] the developer uses major.minor.patch numbers, with the caveat that "major" and "minor" reflect how much an update changes the player's experience rather than how much code changed. Alpha and beta versions are pre-releases for players willing to test unfinished features.<ref>{{Cite changelog|1.12.1-alpha}}</ref>

== In development ==
{{Main|Upcoming features}}
The repository's <code>main</code> branch contains bug fixes made after 1.12.2-beta, listed on the [[Matcha Flavoured 1.12.2|1.12.2]] page. A port to ''Minecraft'' 26.3 was in progress.
